title: 重新接上
intent: 陪伴疲惫后的工作时段：允许短暂停顿，再以不催促的步伐回到手头的事，结束时留下清醒而稍微稳住的感觉。

tempo.feel: 轻微摇摆的中速律动，稳定向前，不急促

tonality.mode: 大调，穿插柔和的九和弦与短暂的小调色彩

instrumentation.name: 原声钢琴
instrumentation.role: 以留白充足的短句担任旋律，柔和和弦支撑其间

instrumentation.name: 原声低音提琴
instrumentation.role: 用简洁、规律的音型维持前进感

instrumentation.name: 爵士鼓
instrumentation.role: 以刷奏和轻柔的镲片维持脉搏
instrumentation.timbre: 细致、低动态，无突出的重击

structure.direction: 钢琴提出简短上行音型，低音提琴与刷奏逐步接入，建立稳定脉搏。
钢琴反复呈示留有呼吸空间的主题；低音与鼓保持轻盈、规律的配合。
主题稍作节奏和声部变化，短暂经过小调色彩；整体音量和密度基本不变。
回到较明亮的主题，钢琴音型略向上伸展，带来一点恢复精力的感觉。
旋律收拢，律动保持到温和明确的终止，不拖慢成催眠式淡出。

production: 干净、亲近的录音室钢琴三重奏；原声乐器音色自然，声部清楚，瞬态平滑，峰值受控，动态始终温和。
assumptions: 采用界面指定的爵士乐类型。
采用应用设置的约三分钟时长，而非简述中的默认两分钟。
选用F大调钢琴三重奏与94 BPM。
lyriaPrompt: An original, gentle piano-trio jazz piece for a tired person steadily returning to focused work, about three minutes long. Instrumental only, no vocals. F major, 4/4 at around 94 BPM, with a light swing and a consistent, unhurried pulse. Warm acoustic piano leads with a small rising motif and spacious, easily followed phrases; upright bass plays simple, regular plucked figures, while brushed drums and quiet cymbals keep the music awake without demanding attention. Use soft major-ninth and sixth chords, with brief minor-color turns that resolve naturally. [Intro] Introduce the piano motif, then bring in bass and brushes. [Theme] Establish the restrained melody and steady groove. [Variation] Gently reshape the motif and harmony without increasing volume or density. [Return] Let the brighter theme regain a little lift. [Outro] Settle into a soft, clear ending without slowing into a lullaby. Keep dynamics even and the instruments distinct. Clean studio recording, natural acoustic timbres, smooth transients and controlled peaks. No sudden loud accents, showy solos, clipping, crackling or digital distortion.
